en: Vintage sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town surrounded by fields and forested hills. In the left foreground stands a prominent church-like tower with a clock, while rows of pitched-roof houses and a few industrial chimneys stretch across the middle ground. The sky is blank and lightly aged, and red printed text at the top identifies the place. Additional small red printing appears in the lower right corner.
